g.text: Ticket / Slice Loop — Implement, Verify, Diagnose, Re-plan
Read Plan + Ticket + shared branch evidence
Acceptance / test strategy / level / cases / command
Property / mutation / E2E / isolation when applicable
A GREEN test level is not enough by itself.
Every acceptance criterion needs executed evidence.
Applicable dimensions must pass or have a concrete N/A reason.
Retry cannot turn unexplained flaky failure into PASS.
